question: Considering only subnets with IP version 4 or 6, list the top 10 RBAC actions (ranked by the subnet IP version range) and show for each action: the action name, the average subnet IP version, the IP version range (max minus min), the variance of the subnet IP version, and whether any of the referenced subnets have DHCP enabled. Do not return any rounded answers.

SELECT
    r.action,
    AVG(s.ip_version) AS avg_ip_version,
    MAX(s.ip_version) - MIN(s.ip_version) AS ip_version_range,
    VAR_SAMP(s.ip_version) AS ip_version_variance,
    MAX(s.enable_dhcp) AS any_dhcp_enabled
FROM networkrbacs r
JOIN subnets s ON s.network_id = r.object_id
WHERE s.ip_version IN (4, 6)
GROUP BY r.action
ORDER BY ip_version_range DESC
LIMIT 10;
